attack_modality.title: AttackModality
attack_modality.description:
Per-attack delivery modality for report display + filtering.

FILE = the attack carries a document (file_url set); TEXT = text-only. This is
a per-row value (distinct from the scan-level include_file_attacks toggle).

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: Document filename (basename of the GCS object key)

signed_url.title: Signed Url
signed_url.description: Short-lived signed GCS download URL; null if the object could not be signed (e.g. missing signBlob permission).

file_type.title: File Type
file_type.description: Short document type, e.g. PDF / DOCX / MD

anyOf.title: AttackFileSchema
anyOf.description:
Structured file reference for a multimodal (document) attack in the report.

Exposed only on the attack **detail** response. The list response conveys type via
``attack_modality`` (FILE/TEXT) and carries no file object.

file.description: File-attack document (name + signed download URL + short type); null for text attacks
